KeyConcepts.Title: Tens and ones
KeyConcepts.Definition: Separate teen factor into ten and remaining ones.

KeyConcepts.Title: Multiple models
KeyConcepts.Definition: Concrete blocks, gridded and ungridded areas can share one product.

KeyConcepts.Title: The distributive relationship stays true across models
KeyConcepts.Definition: Represent equal groups of teen numbers using tens and ones without changing the product.
KeyConcepts.Rule: Multiply each part by the same number of groups and combine their values; justify the original array, base-ten, and area diagrams separately.
